material.title: Foxit PDF Reader Doc Object Use-After-Free Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed CVE-2026-57256 affecting Foxit PDF Reader. Exploitation requires a user to open malicious content; the use-after-free can disclose information and may be useful only when chained with another flaw. Foxit has released an update.

material.title: Cisco Identity Services Engine MnTRESTLivelogService XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed CVE-2026-20235 in Cisco Identity Services Engine. Exploitation requires authentication with high privileges and can disclose information through XXE processing. Cisco has released an update.

material.title: Linux Kernel TLS Protocol Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed CVE-2026-64046 in the Linux kernel TLS implementation. A local attacker must already be able to execute high-privileged code; the flaw can read beyond an allocated array and disclose information. A kernel fix is available.

material.title: Linux Kernel NTFS3 Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed an NTFS3 out-of-bounds read in the Linux kernel. Exploitation requires local low-privileged code and primarily provides information disclosure that could be chained with another weakness. The Linux kernel has been updated.

material.title: Linux Kernel MCTP Routing Uninitialized Memory Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed CVE-2026-45930 in Linux kernel MCTP routing. The attacker must already be able to execute high-privileged local code; the issue exposes uninitialized memory and is mainly useful as part of a chain. A kernel fix is available.

material.title: Linux Kernel Open vSwitch Flow Delete Use-After-Free Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed CVE-2026-80994 in Linux Open vSwitch. Exploitation is local, requires existing low privileges and high complexity, and primarily enables information disclosure for potential chaining. The kernel has been patched.

material.title: Adobe Acrobat Reader DC Font Parsing Use-After-Free Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed CVE-2026-80162 in Adobe Acrobat Reader DC font parsing. Exploitation requires the victim to open malicious content and the direct impact is information disclosure; Adobe has released an update.

material.title: Adobe Acrobat Reader DC JPEG2000 File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed CVE-2026-79910 in Adobe Acrobat Reader DC JPEG2000 parsing. User interaction is required, the direct impact is an out-of-bounds read and information disclosure, and Adobe has issued an update.

material.title: Oracle VirtualBox VirtioSCSI Uninitialized Memory Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed CVE-2026-71132 in Oracle VirtualBox VirtioSCSI. The attacker must already have high privileges in the guest; the flaw can disclose uninitialized hypervisor memory. Oracle has released an update.

material.title: Oracle VirtualBox VirtioSCSI Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed CVE-2026-71114 in Oracle VirtualBox VirtioSCSI. Exploitation requires high privileges inside the guest and the direct effect is an out-of-bounds read that can disclose hypervisor information. Oracle has patched the issue.

material.title: NI LabVIEW VI File Parsing Out-Of-Bounds Read Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed CVE-2026-18444 in NI LabVIEW VI file parsing. A victim must open malicious content; the direct impact is a low-severity out-of-bounds read and information disclosure. NI has issued an update.

material.title: Microsoft Azure Entra ID OAuth Device Code Grant Information Disclosure Vulnerability
material.bodyOriginal: ZDI disclosed an information-disclosure issue in the Azure Entra ID OAuth Device Code Grant endpoint. It can reveal limited internal organizational information for Entra ID tenants without authentication. Microsoft fixed the issue in an updated version; no active exploitation is reported.

material.title: Critical F5 BIG-IP Vulnerability Exploited as Zero-Day
material.bodyOriginal: SecurityWeek reported that F5 and CISA warned of active exploitation of CVE-2026-94127 in BIG-IP APM. The CVSS 9.8 flaw can allow unauthenticated remote code execution in affected configurations. F5 released hotfixes and CISA added the bug to KEV with a three-day federal patch deadline.

material.title: Check Point Patches Exploited Management Server Zero-Day
material.bodyOriginal: SecurityWeek reported active exploitation of CVE-2026-93616, a CVSS 9.8 Check Point Management Server directory-traversal and file-upload flaw that can let unauthenticated attackers execute arbitrary scripts. Check Point released urgent fixes and indicators of compromise, and CISA added the flaw to KEV.

material.title: Active Exploitation Triggers Emergency Patch for Cisco ISE Zero-Day
material.bodyOriginal: SecurityWeek reported that Cisco released emergency fixes for CVE-2026-76460, a maximum-severity Identity Services Engine API authentication-bypass vulnerability exploited in the wild. Remote unauthenticated attackers can send crafted requests to bypass the management interface; ISE and ISE-PIC are affected.

material.title: PaperCut Exploitation Escalates to Active Intrusions
material.bodyOriginal: SecurityWeek reported active intrusions exploiting CVE-2026-82078 and CVE-2026-81578 in PaperCut NG/MF. Attackers can chain the flaws for authentication bypass and remote code execution. PaperCut issued emergency patches, including a second patch after the first mitigation was bypassed, and CISA added the bugs to KEV.

material.title: Microsoft SharePoint Flaw CVE-2026-65660 Now Exploited in Attacks
material.bodyOriginal: SecurityWeek reported that Microsoft had reliable evidence of exploitation of CVE-2026-65660, a SharePoint Server code-injection vulnerability allowing an authenticated low-privilege attacker to execute arbitrary code without user interaction. Microsoft had patched it in August and CISA added it to KEV.

material.title: 'Warlock' ransomware used in attacks on critical infrastructure in Portuguese, Spanish-speaking countries
material.bodyOriginal: The Record reported that a China-linked group using Warlock ransomware was attacking critical-infrastructure organizations across Europe, Africa and Latin America. Symantec identified victims including a water utility, a telecom provider, a university and a regional government, with attackers exploiting Microsoft SharePoint vulnerabilities.

material.title: US, UK warn of exploited Citrix NetScaler zero-day bugs
material.bodyOriginal: The Record reported urgent government warnings over Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway vulnerabilities. Citrix confirmed eight new flaws, with CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 actively exploited; both have severity scores of 9.5 and patches were released.

material.title: ShinyHunters exploiting workarounds for Oracle PeopleSoft bug, Mandiant warns
material.bodyOriginal: The Record reported Mandiant findings that ShinyHunters resumed exploitation of CVE-2026-35273 in Oracle PeopleSoft and adapted to organizations that used published workarounds without installing the patch. The product is widely used in government, education and healthcare.

material.title: Cyberattack encrypts systems at Bavarian municipal utility
material.bodyOriginal: The Record reported that Stadtwerke Landsberg, a municipal utility in Bavaria, had its central IT network encrypted in a cyberattack. Office systems and customer communications were disrupted, the utility isolated systems and activated crisis response, while electricity and water services remained operational.

material.title: Apple Zero-Day Vulnerability Weaponized in Targeted Attacks
material.bodyOriginal: Dark Reading reported that Apple released iOS and macOS updates for CVE-2026-86950, a CoreGraphics out-of-bounds write vulnerability with CVSS 8.8 that Apple says was actively exploited in sophisticated targeted attacks. The flaw can enable arbitrary code execution on affected devices.

material.title: SonicWall SMA 1000 Zero-Days Enable Unauthenticated RCE
material.bodyOriginal: Dark Reading reported active exploitation of two zero-day vulnerabilities in SonicWall SMA 1000 perimeter devices. CVE-2026-83548 is a pre-authentication SSRF flaw scored 10.0 and CVE-2026-83549 is a post-authentication remote-code-execution flaw; customers were urged to patch immediately.

material.title: DIVD says Zammad zero-days enabled AI-driven network breach
material.bodyOriginal: BleepingComputer reported that the Dutch Institute for Vulnerability Disclosure traced a breach of its own network to a chain of two Zammad zero-day vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-102489 and CVE-2026-102490. The chain enabled session hijacking, remote code execution and escalation to root, after which data was accessed and exfiltrated. DIVD urged Zammad users to upgrade to version 7 or take vulnerable instances offline.
